## Description

Create `mobile/clinician` and `mobile/patient` (expo-router, bottom sheets, secure-store, encrypted expo-sqlite, expo-localization with forceRTL for Arabic, Dynamic Type to 200 %). One tokens file feeds web CSS variables and the native theme (clinic teal, patient indigo). Reuse `packages/i18n/messages` (en, hi, ar). Lint layer rules as ADR-009 (`domain`, `services`, `hooks`, `components`). CI: type-check, unit tests, EAS preview builds, `pnpm audit`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the workspace, when CI runs, then both apps type-check, lint, test and produce an EAS preview build.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given Arabic is selected, when the app restarts, then layout is right-to-left while dates and phone numbers stay left-to-right.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a string is hard-coded in a component, when lint runs, then the build fails.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the tokens file changes, when web and native build, then both pick up the same colours and spacing.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
